title: Image Filter
text: 2-D FIR filtering, 3 inputs, 2 outputs, {Padding method} sets Method for padding; {Filter coefficients source} sets the source to provide filter coefficients, {Filter coefficients} sets the coefficients of filter {Padding value} sets the value used to pad boundary of input image, {Line buffer size} sets the size of line buffer, {Rounding mode} sets the rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations, {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the overflow action for internal fixed-point, {Coefficients} sets the filter coefficients data type, {Output} and {Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools}. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Method for padding Constant (default) | Replicate | Symmetric | Reflection | None

params.values: Value used to pad boundary of input image 0 (default) | integer

params.values: Rounding method for internal fixed-point calculations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Zero

params.values: Overflow action for internal fixed-point calculations off (default) | on
